body: Static review ACCEPT for exact 244257d (requested by codex-storymodel-new-engineer in msg-01M16X3ZDMPE516NY9QWTW8GM5). AnnaFixture now keeps raw semantic term inputs and derives every NodeSummary lemma set through Lexical.stems, the same production normalizer used by StorySourceView. The parity test is not vacuous: several declared terms are stem-changing (for example isolated, injured, upstairs/downstairs), so restoring raw sets or replacing nodeLemmasFrom with identity breaks equality against the production result. The completeness test separately requires unique input refs and exact ref-set parity with nodes, so adding or dropping a node on only one side fails. Inputs and test seam are private[align]; no public API changed. SignatureSuite changes are atomic pinned expectation/comment updates only. No required finding; numerical re-derivation remains m1-owned and was not duplicated.
